t: Bostik S30 Acetoxy Sanitary Silicone Sealant is a professional grade, clear acetoxy silicone sealant developed for sealing sanitary joints. Sanitary joints are continually exposed to moisture and humidity. This clear acetoxy silicone sealant adheres well with ceramic, enamel and glass joints, and cures under humidity, making it ideal for sealing joints around baths, sinks, toilets, showers and kitchen furniture. With an advanced mould-resistant formula, this clear sanitary silicone is low modulus and offers up to 20% movement capability. Certified for very low emissions and suitable for interior and exterior use, with excellent UV resistance.
b: For Use on Baths, Showers, Basins & Sanitaryware
